items.title: Novo Nordisk's raised forecast fails to change the debate over its obesity business
items.description: Wall Street isn't convinced the Ozempic maker has a promising path back to sustainable growth as competition from Eli Lilly intensifies.

items.title: Europe is blowing up riverbeds as an extreme drought wreaks havoc on its economy
items.description: Severe drought is disrupting energy and freight across Europe as low Rhine and Danube levels raise risks for supply chains and economic growth.

items.title: India's central bank keeps benchmark rates steady, cites 'moderate' core inflation
items.description: The Reserve Bank of India has kept interest rates unchanged amid creeping inflation.

items.title: U.S. says Strait of Hormuz is 'free and open' as Bessent signals deal with Iran is close
items.description: U.S. Central Command said the "southern route of the Strait of Hormuz remains free and open"

items.title: GM, Chinese automaker extend joint venture for 20 years despite geopolitical tensions with U.S.
items.description: GM said the deal will focus on domestic sales of Buick and Cadillac models in China and exporting Chevrolet products built in China for non-U.S. markets.

items.title: SpaceX's AI spending unnerves Wall Street despite promises of quick payoff
items.description: In addressing Wall Street for the first time since SpaceX's IPO, executives tried to make the case that hefty AI investments are paying off within a year.

items.title: SoftBank jumps 10% as Asia tech stocks track Wall Street AI rally
items.description: Asian technology stocks rallied on Wednesday after Wall Street's record-setting session fueled optimism around artificial intelligence and growth stocks.

items.title: China's super-rich 'in shock' and hunting for cash as Beijing issues surprise tax on offshore trusts
items.description: Beijing's move to tax offshore trusts, long used by China's ultra-rich to hold money, has set off a rush to lawyers and a scramble for cash.

items.title: Europe's heatwave isn't cooling Asian travelers' holiday plans for the continent
items.description: Asian travelers' appetite for Europe remains resilient despite record-breaking heat, with spending in Northern Europe projected to increase.

items.title: Lucid begins 'operational reset' as CEO says EV maker will delay midsize vehicle
items.description: The company didn't provide updated guidance. New CEO Silvio Napoli earlier this year suspended production expectations.

items.title: How the 'Baby iPhone' and an Apple supplier leak explain China's recent supply chain moves
items.description: In China's biggest electronics marketplace, Huaqiangbei, technicians don't have the parts to make exact copies of Apple's latest phones.

items.title: Pinterest shares fall on lukewarm sales guidance
items.description: Pinterest reported better-than-expected earnings and revenue for the second quarter, though its forecast was online in line with estimates.

items.title: Jim Cramer says one hedge fund's collapse cleared the way for tech's rally
items.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said the collapse of AI-focused hedge fund Situational Awareness removed a major source of forced selling.

items.title: AMD's revenue climbs 50% and data center sales doubled, but the stock is down
items.description: AMD's data center unit is driving the company's growth, up 107% over last year.

items.title: Sen. Susan Collins will oppose Blanche, a critical blow for Trump's AG pick
items.description: Attorney General nominee Todd Blanche needs at least 50 votes on the Senate floor to be confirmed after clearing the Senate Judiciary Committee.

items.title: Michael Burry bets against rally: 'We are near a major top, and possible a 1987-type fall'
items.description: "I continue to believe it is possible we are near a major top, and possible a 1987-type fall," Burry said in a Tuesday Substack post.

items.title: Paramount Skydance raises full-year profit guidance, remains 'confident' about WBD merger
items.description: Paramount Skydance reported second-quarter earnings after the bell and said it continues to prepare for its proposed merger with Warner Bros. Discovery.

items.title: The stock market soars. 5 reasons behind the big surge Tuesday
items.description: The Dow had its best day in nearly two months and the S&P 500 rose to new highs.

items.title: Chipotle stock falls on potential link to salmonella outbreak in Minnesota
items.description: Chipotle has pulled the affected supply from restaurants and replaced them with peppers from different growers, according to the company.

items.title: Palantir stock skyrockets 29%, narrowly missing its best day ever after 'otherworldly' results
items.description: "Our customers have declined to become vassal states of the language labs," Palantir's co-founder and CEO Alex Karp said after blowout second-quarter earnings.
